item.title: Self-Hosted DNS RPZ Management: BIND vs PowerDNS vs Knot DNS
item.description: DNS Response Policy Zone (RPZ), also known as DNS Firewall, is a powerful mechanism for intercepting and rewriting DNS queries based on policy rules. Originally introduced in BIND 9.8, RPZ has become a standard feature across major DNS server implementations. It allows organizations to block malicious domains, enforce content filtering, redirect internal traffic, and implement threat intelligence feeds — all at the DNS layer.
